rules.title: Measure BB (Berkeley Rent Ordinance amendments) – Annual General Adjustment cap
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment, the yearly amount a landlord of a fully covered unit may raise rent, is set by a CPI-based formula but capped at 5%. The cap does not stop landlords with banked AGAs from raising rent above 5% up to the rent ceiling. Government-owned or -subsidized units become fully or partially covered.
rules.status_basis: Passed by voters in the November 2024 election; effective date not stated for this provision.

requires.name: fully_covered_unit
requires.text: The AGA is the amount by which the landlord of a fully-covered rental unit may raise the rent each year.

coverage.summary: Applies to fully covered rental units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Partially covered and exempt units are not subject to the rent ceiling.

rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.

rules.title: Measure BB (Berkeley Rent Ordinance amendments) – just cause eviction changes
rules.requirement: Tenants in fully or partially covered units can be evicted only for just cause. Measure BB bars eviction for nonpayment where the debt is under one month of Fair Market Rent, and for failing to sign a new lease. Lease-breach evictions require substantial actual harm and unreasonable tenant behavior, and notices must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days.
rules.key_value: Rental debt of at least one month of HUD Fair Market Rent required for nonpayment eviction
rules.status_basis: Passed by voters in the November 2024 election.

requires.name: covered_unit
requires.text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause"

coverage.summary: Applies to fully or partially covered units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
